purpose: Point-in-time governed authority for SHFE price-limit (涨跌停板) rules for cu, al, ni, au, ag, rb over 2024-01-01..2025-12-31. Reduces LIMIT-001 by binding the contract-text base daily price-limit rule per effective period and explicitly classifying per-day exchange-adjustment and special-day layers as GAP / UNKNOWN / RETRIEVAL_BLOCKED. It never backfills historical values with a current rule and never fabricates a per-day fact.

No challenge was bypassed. Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) returned HTTP 429 this pass. Base-limit evidence below is therefore bound from already-committed repository official evidence (E06 hashed contract pages S01-S06 and CANONICAL_CONTRACT_SPECS.json binding-notice chain), not from a fresh live retrieval.

first_trading_day_new_listing.note: Whether the price limit differs on the first trading day of a newly listed contract month is governed by SHFE risk-control rules (S10). That official text was not bound this pass (RETRIEVAL_BLOCKED / Wayback 429). No value or exception is asserted.

resumption_after_suspension.note: Whether the price limit differs on resumption of trading after suspension is governed by SHFE risk-control rules (S10). Not bound this pass; no value or exception is asserted.

consecutive_same_direction_limit.note: Whether the price limit expands after consecutive same-direction limit sessions (multi-tier handling) is governed by SHFE risk-control rules (S10). Not bound this pass; no value or exception is asserted.

pre_holiday_adjustment.note: Whether exchange price-limit adjustments were in force before/around holidays for these products during 2024-2025 is governed by official exchange notices. No bound notice for the window; no value or exception is asserted.

fail_closed_interface.policy: resolve_per_day returns BOUND only when exactly one bound per-day fact exists in per_day_facts; otherwise it returns UNKNOWN (or CONFLICT on non-identical duplicates). The authority NEVER derives a per-day operative fact from a base rule and NEVER applies a current rule to a historical day. Execution simulation that claims a real price-limit fill for any 2024-2025 day must consume an exactly-one bound per-day fact; with none bound, the claim is rejected (fail closed).
fail_closed_interface.consumer_note: This prep binds the rule authority and the fail-closed interface. Absolute per-day lower/upper bounds additionally require the official previous-settlement price per concrete contract per day, which is outside this rule-metadata prep and remains unbound for a future governed step.
